profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company with the ticker ALNT, headquartered in Williamsville, New York, and registered with CIK 0000046129. Its website, at alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia.

According to the site, the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors. It describes a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while operating with autonomy, and it says its people are personally invested in Alantra. The company states that its ambition is to support clients with the best advice and products, delivered through what it calls an accountable and ethical approach to business.

The facts held on the company list no products, no MCP servers, and no cases. New York appears as a jurisdiction of legal exposure, with a count of 424.
